notes.title: At 03:00pm CEST / 08:00am CDT we will release version 1.12!

items.text: This seasonal update includes not only new event items but new weather conditions, vehicle features, and more that we will talk about in this post. This update will not come with any wipe, all of your progress will be maintained
⚠️During the patch deployment servers may be temporarily unavailable. Game client update is required.
The Modkit will be rebuilt with the update. Mod authors should make sure to test and verify that their mods continue to function correctly after the update deployment. ⚠️

Lets begin with one of the most anticipated features coming in this version; Weather! With a bit of technical work we have added a new cloud system, allowing for dynamic cloud cover that casts shadows on objects below. The sky can now shift between three different states: clear, cloudy, or overcast. In future updates we would like to continue to improve this weather system with even more types of weather conditions.

With this update releasing in October, it's only fitting that we begin our annual Halloween event. But this time instead of adding the same event items you are used to we wanted to make it more interesting. We created and added new items and event features for you to find in game. Pumpkin decorations can be found in gardens, fields, and greenhouses. Tombstones, statues, candles, and skeleton parts can be found in cemeteries. While you are there you will notice a new mysterious altar which you can use to craft pumpkin and skull lanterns, and assemble a skeleton that can be used as a mannequin.

All of this is included with all of the Halloween items you have seen in past updates. But if this is your first Halloween event, that means finding AI wearing seasonal helmets and sporting weapons with seasonal skins. There is also a high chance of looting these weapon skins from containers around the world.

As always our art team is working to improve Mirny with each update. This time they have improved the Pyramid POI by expanding the perimeter of the complex. The city of Kamensk has been worked on as well, with some visual corrections and improvements to the area.

Lastly we have a few miscellaneous features like increased grenade throw range, higher blueprint folder spawns in military and industrial POIs, and two new random weapon blueprint cases available for purchase at the traders. And with that we have covered everything in version 1.12!

Let us know what you think about this update, and what you would like to see in the next one! The best place to do that is our Nolt page, a platform where you can submit ideas and vote on the ideas of others. We watch that page and periodically update the posts there to let you know what we are working on. Thanks for reading, for those interested we have the full patch notes below. Enjoy the update and seasonal event!
Improved vehicle collision physics. Vehicles can now push each other
Tire durability has been significantly improved.
The ability to select a specific seat in the car using the Ctrl+1-4 key combination.
The driver can honk the horn by pressing the “fire” button.

items.text: Version 1.11 will be released later today at 12:00PM CEST / 5:00AM CDT!
⚠️Warning: Due to changes with vehicle mechanics we are forced to delete existing vehicles on release so that the update functions correctly
Modders may need to update their mods in the 1.11 Modkit build for them to function

This update comes with new content that we will cover today, as well as a ton of balance changes all made according to your feedback. Let’s begin with some of the content we haven’t covered in the last WIP post:

Let's begin with even more vehicle features, starting with a new vehicle speed boost! Now if you press Shift while driving a vehicle you will get a boost in speed at the cost of increased fuel consumption. Useful for getting out of dangerous situations, not so useful for long distance trips.

This update won’t just be making vehicles stronger though, you now have a new way to combat them. You can now shoot out the tires of a vehicle with a handful of accurate shots. The amount of shots depends on the damage being dealt by your weapon. This slows down the vehicle considerably if all tires are destroyed, allowing you to shift focus to the now exposed passengers.

The last new vehicle feature we have for you in this update is a cosmetic one; vehicle skins! With this new DLC, you can press U on your vehicle to reskin it at any time. This skin pack comes with 4 different skin variations, if you are interested check it out here:

In addition to that there have been a bunch of vehicle balance changes, all of which you can read in a list at the bottom of this post. These changes were all made based on requests from the community, we appreciate the feedback. Covering everything briefly; vehicles lose durability slower, consume a bit less gas, and spawn more often.

Another change is how vehicle storage works, now your mechanic’s workbench needs to be within line of sight of the vehicle for it to be maintained. This is to prevent any sort of situation where another player leaves vehicles at someone else’s base to drain their supplies. Here is an example of how we intend it to work in 1.11:
We have already covered the new animal a few times before in previous posts, but for those who aren’t caught up; version 1.11 will add boars!

These new boars have the most HP of any animal in game, but also drop the most resources. Boars provide good food, a head for decoration, and fat that can be converted into machine oil. First render the fat in a campfire, then combine with other materials at an Advanced Workbench to create Machine Oil.

As always the art team continues to improve Mirny, this time around they have given the popular Khimash POI a fresh coat of paint. The overall layout is retained, with more added details and a bit more cover to use. Other locations have been improved as well, so keep an eye out while roaming around.

The blueprints menu has been improved as well, now displaying the crafting recipes of all items. This means you don't have to look at a workbench just to figure out what items you need to be collecting. There will also be repair and dismantling workbenches added to the safe zone, making repair easier on the move.

When it comes to balance changes you all have had a lot of feedback for us recently, and we have been listening. Version 1.11 will come with a lot of balance tweaks based on your feedback, so many that it would be easier for everyone if it was in a list. So let us know what you think about these changes! Tomorrow at 9AM CEST / 2AM CDT, we will begin the release of version 1.10!
During the patch deployment, servers may be temporarily unavailable. Game client update is required
The Modkit will be rebuilt with the update. Mod authors should make sure to test and verify that their mods continue to function correctly after the update deployment.
Update 1.10 is focused on bringing you new content, while making some minor changes and bug fixes in the background of course. Here are the most notable features you can expect to see:
New Prison and Port POI in E5
Unique mission in the Prison location featuring a heavy-armored boss
New weapons — Improvised Crossbow & Mosin Launcher
New consumable — Prison tea
New decorative items that can be found in the Prison location
New heavy armor —available in damaged condition from the boss only, but can also be crafted
New item — Gold Watch for reputation

In addition, we’ve made important balance improvements to the systems that affect the overall gameplay experience. Based on your feedback, we’ve significantly reduced the amount of resources required to upkeep vehicles at the base, while also adding new blueprint spawn points in the form of folders. Furthermore, blueprints can now spawn in the game world in stacks, increasing their availability and improving progression in the early stages of the game.
Thank you for helping us make the game better. Now let’s take a closer look at the new features in this update.

Taking a look at the new areas around E5, we have a new port and a high security prison complex, both featuring new missions. Additionally, Epic Missions now feature a heavily armored boss. This boss is much tougher than your average AI, carrying high tier weapons and new heavy armor that can only be found on him. Encountering the boss in cramped interior spaces like those found in the prison could lead to a very deadly situation.

Also included in this version are two new improvised weapons, the Crossbow and Mosin Launcher. First up is the Crossbow, an affordable weapon that can be thrown together with a few weapon parts, a couple planks, one machine oil and a blowtorch. Its ammo is even easier to make, just a couple planks and some nails. The Crossbow delivers deadly blows silently, making it an extremely useful tool for those who prefer to stay stealthy. But the projectile is slow and not the most accurate, limiting its range

This update also brings the Mosin Launcher, a weapon created by welding some attachments to a normal Mosin-K. This allows it to fire improvised explosive grenades, another new and very deadly craftable item. Compared to the GRM-40, the projectiles of this improvised launcher fly slower and have less range. Plus the sights aren’t as clean. Even still a grenade launcher can still be an extremely effective weapon, improvised or not.

Version 1.10 adds a new drink to the game, Tea! Specifically Prison Tea, an extremely strong tea with a massive dose of caffeine. It allows you to run and reload 20% faster for 15 minutes, at the cost of -25 food. You can even craft this yourself if you find a few boxes of tea lying around.

Lastly we have the new decorative items that can be found at the new Prison POI. These include a bunch of new posters, plus table top games like Chess, Backgammon and Cards! Also found at the prison and other areas is a new rare gold watch that can be sold for extra reputation.

Hello Deadsiders!
On May 7th at 11AM CEST / 4AM CDT we will release update 1.9.1!
At the same time, we also plan to open 4 more PvE servers in Europe to reduce queue times.
This balance patch is based directly on feedback from our community. We have been carefully listening to the concerns shared by our players, and in this update we hope to address some of them.

Our goal is to find the right balance between survival challenge and gameplay comfort. Some of the changes in this update may not look radical, but this is an important step toward finding that “golden middle ground” where the game remains immersive and challenging while also being enjoyable and less frustrating to play.

Getting into the changes, first lets cover food and water. We have seen feedback from players saying they feel like they are forced to gather food and water too often during gameplay, restricting what they can do. So we have made multiple changes to keep hunting rewarding while increasing the amount of time your character is satiated.

Food and water drain has been reduced by 10% to 33%, depending on the player's actions. The only thing that hasn't changed is water loss while sprinting. The character now has 25 minimal food and water on a respawn. The amount of food from forageables has been increased slightly as well to keep you alive early game. Importantly though, cooked meat now increases the maximum amount of food and water. +25 for fish, +35 for duck, and +30 for deer. Duck meat also increases your max HP slightly (+4), with deer giving a better bonus of (+6). The effects stack, so you can increase your satiety value up to 200.

These changes mean that you won’t be hungry as often if you invest the time into gathering good meat. This keeps the hunting rewarding, while restricting you as a player less during normal gameplay. As an added bonus, mission rewards now have a chance to drop canned food as well.

Another area of improvement in this update is a reduction to weapon maintenance and crafting costs. Generally reduced by ~10%, though the specific values can be found in the patch notes down below. Your supply of machine oil and other repair items will now take you further, allowing for more crafting and upgrades.

Loot spawning is being adjusted as well, with base materials like nails, planks, and rope spawning in larger quantities. Getting a basic base started will now take less looting time to keep progression smooth.

Lastly, the rate that vehicles slow down from damage has been reduced. Now if your vehicle is above 50% durability, you will be able to travel at full speed. This allows you to operate a vehicle for longer without stopping for repair, rewarding those who invest the time maintaining their vehicles.

Those are most of the big changes included in this update, check out the patch notes below for all the details. We are still listening to feedback and will continue to make changes, so please let us know what you think!

On Wednesday the 29th at 11AM CEST / 4AM CDT, we will release version 1.9!

Version 1.9 is easily the largest update so far this year, bringing huge expansions to progression, crafting, and the Mirny map itself. Balance changes have been made to loot spawning, AI, trader prices, medical items, vehicles, the list goes on. On top of that we have new base structures and decorative items for you to craft and construct.
Thank you to everyone who sent in feedback during the extended testing period, it helped a lot when dialing in balance and hunting bugs.
The release of this update to the live servers will require a wipe. All items, bases, safezone storage and player inventories will need to be reset for the update to function correctly on release.
We cover everything included in this update below, but if you would prefer to see these features in game our CM Boots has created a video covering the entire update:

One of the biggest changes coming in version 1.9 is the new blueprint system, aimed to expand and deepen progression, and the in-game item economy. This has opened up the ability to research, craft, and upgrade items all at your base. You can view your blueprint progression in the new blueprints tab in your inventory. Here crafting recipes are unlocked by finding blueprint fragments.

Blueprint fragments can be found anywhere from car trunks to airdrops, with rare fragments dropping from high tier events. Or you can use the new research table to convert an item into its corresponding blueprint.

Some blueprints, specifically weapons and armor can be continually upgraded to higher levels. Each level unlocks a new upgrade that can be applied at the upgrade station. This allows players who invest the time into gathering the required blueprints and materials to have access to improved kit.
Another huge feature of 1.9 is a large expansion to the Mirny map! Lets go through each new area
The Potny island has been added into Mirny, located E6-7
Added a Scrapyard to I10, offering lots of scrap to loot
Added a farm to G10
Added a construction site to H3
Added a village to K9
Added a village to J10
Added an oil storage facility to J7

Another new island has appeared next to the Potny islands. This island is currently completely empty, but many interesting things will appear on it in the near future. Keep an eye on our socials for news on this island.

Signal flares can be found in the world, or purchased from traders. This new item can be thrown down to call an airdrop wherever you like! Each color of signal flare provides airdrop loot from a different category. Red provides weapons, ammo, and explosives. Green provides gear and armor. Blue provides resources and crafting materials. Purple provides food and medicine. So if you are missing supplies in a certain area, you can have them delivered directly to your base.

Last update we got a lot of feedback on the subject of weapon repair, so we have decided to simplify it in this version. You no longer need unique weapon parts specific to that weapon, instead there are weapon components with different types, and tier. For example a tier 2 sniper needs tier 2 sniper parts for repair.

That being said, weapon repair will require a few other materials like machine oil, sterile rags, and weapon components. These common parts are used for all sorts of weapon crafting and upgrading in 1.9.
Bases will be getting new structures as well, for example offset doors. These make it much easier to navigate your base using stairs, and give builders more options.
We have also added a fireplace, which is now the most efficient way to cook your food on top of just looking nice

An important crafting item added in this version is the CNC Machine. This is the highest level of crafting workbench, allowing you to craft high tier items if you have the blueprint and materials required. The CNC Machine will allow you to craft many useful items that you would previously only purchase or find.
The last base addition are 4 decorative face masks, which can be either placed on your wall or crafted into a wearable version

With all of these big changes coming to crafting and progression, it only makes sense that loot spawning and traders have been rebalanced as well. There are a lot of minor changes made here, but big picture is that high level gear is generally harder to acquire. Now that you can craft a lot of it yourself, we needed to reduce accessibility in some areas to prevent high level gear becoming too common overall. So high level weapons and armor have been removed from the traders, and ground spawns. The best way to get them now is through high level events, or crafting.

That being said, high level gear is still technically available at the trader through random lootboxes that you can purchase with in-game money. This gives you something fun to do with your money at end game stages, or potentially a way to get powerful gear early if you are willing to gamble

As bases become more important to gameplay, the balance of explosive spawns for raiding has become more important as well. In version 1.9 explosive spawns lying on the ground in the world have been removed. This means to gather explosives you will need to do events like missions, helicrashes, or call down airdrops. Not only does this result in more fair gameplay, it prevents explosive gathering from becoming a stale experience of farming the same world locations over and over.

In version 1.9 we have been talking a lot about crafting and base building, but an important aspect of a survival game is keeping your character alive by eating and drinking. These elements have been in Deadside for a long time, but we aim to make them more relevant in this update.

One big change being a significantly reduced amount of canned food and bottled water in the world. Water wells will be a dangerous hotspot for players again unless you have water collectors at your base.

Food will still be available at traders, and there are many other sources to gather food from across the world. Deer spawns have been increased, you can hunt duck, fish, gather apples, berries, mussels, or mushrooms.

To keep this system fair you will now respawn with the amount of food and water that you died with. This is nice if you spent the time collecting food and water, not so great if you ignored these needs. In the case these stats reach zero, you will respawn with these values slightly increased so that you have a chance.

This approach to improving survival and progression applies to vehicles as well, so we are looking to expand vehicle maintenance. Before a player can constantly use a vehicle long term, they will first need to repair and refuel the vehicle they found for it to be useful. With this approach vehicles are treated more like a luxury that you need to invest in. It's also worth noting that the vehicle cap has been largely increased in version 1.9. This keeps vehicles easy to find while not being overly present during normal gameplay. The final design of this system is still being worked on, potentially requiring specific parts to be installed or repaired. In the meantime the changes to vehicles below reflect this approach to balance within existing systems;
Vehicles now gradually wear out during long usage
Added audio for damaged vehicles with more breakdown sounds occurring as vehicles wear down
Vehicles now spawn in the world slightly damaged

Many of you are likely familiar with the loot crates opened by red keys. These gray crates offer weapons with unique skins, however they present a problem in gameplay where players can get high level items with very low risk. So in version 1.9 locked crates will drop the new skin applicator instead of a weapon. These are single use items that can be used to apply unique skins to weapons, keeping the original purpose of locked crates while improving gameplay balance.

Lastly, let's talk about AI balance. With the recent weapon rebalance included in the last update, we got feedback that they had the effect of making AI too accurate and dangerous. We have seen that some elements of update 1.8 have been met with mixed feedback from the community. Radical changes were made to several core systems, and we have gotten many suggestions to fix problems and make improvements. We hear you, and we’re taking steps to set things right.
We plan to release update 1.8.0.4 on Monday, in the meantime read through the changes and let us know what you think!
Disabled AI damage to player bases
Increased headshot damage on unhelmeted AI for lethal headshots
Weapon repair parts added to the "Tools" section at Traders

Our goal was to make convoy hunting more challenging for players who prefer sniping bots from the safety of a "two-minute" twig base. We felt that upgrading to a log-tier base was a fair trade-off for that tactical advantage. However, some players began exploiting this mechanic to lure AI toward other players' bases, leading to total griefing and destruction. To prevent these unpleasant surprises, we are reverting this change. Your bases are safe once again.

The recent weapon balance overhaul was intended to specialize weapon roles and make PvP more predictable. We wanted to ensure a stray pistol shot from a distance wouldn't result in an instant player death. Because of this, headshot damage was significantly reduced, leaving only sniper rifles capable of one-tap kills (excluding helmets).

Unfortunately, this unintentionally turned bots into bullet sponges. We are adjusting headshot values so that any weapon in good condition will kill an unhelmeted bot with a single headshot, provided you are within half of the weapon's effective range.

The new repair system was the biggest point of contention. In 1.8, we significantly increased weapon durability (by 2–3x on average), meaning a mint-condition gun won't lose 50% of its durability in a single mission. To balance the economy, we made repairs more expensive and introduced a more realistic system involving unique parts and Machine Oil.

The idea was to add a new dimension to the meta: weapon rarity. We wanted maintaining your favorite high-tier gun to feel like an achievement rather than just a button click. However, we agree that costs became prohibitive for especially rare gear.
As a temporary solution: Traders now stock unique repair parts. These will be significantly cheaper than buying a brand-new gun just to scrap it for parts.
The Future: We are planning a more robust fix by introducing a blueprint system that will allow you to craft these unique parts yourselves.
We are also currently working on expanding the crafting system, which will include a new workbench and the aforementioned blueprints.
Stay tuned for more updates, and let us know what you think about these changes!

In our previous post about the public test we go into much more detail, you can also check our official wiki on release for the full stats if you are interested.
Also coming in this update is the massive .50cal R-12 revolver! It has a slow rate of fire and not the best accuracy, but deals a scary 135 damage with each shot.

One highly requested feature getting added this update are SMG and AR suppressors. These silencers don’t actually silence the weapon, like real life they only reduce the sound signature to make your reports harder to pinpoint. They won’t last forever though, eventually you will burn through your suppressor's durability that can’t be repaired. These attachments are rare, but we have added a bottle suppressor that you can craft. It has very low durability as you would expect, but it works in a pinch.

Along with an overhaul to weapons, we have also changed up the crafting and workbench system. Lots of crafting will now be done at your base at a workbench, with more complex recipes requiring the more expensive advanced workbench. Each weapon now has its own individual part, ensuring that rare weapons require rare parts for maintenance.

Update 1.8 brings more additions to your base with sloped roofing, wall carpets, and mannequins! Now you can display your armor, mount carpets on walls, all under a traditional looking roof.

Some additions have been made to Mirny as well, with new industrial zone buildings. The sand quarry POI had its industrial zone improved with new assets, and the sawmill at G4 has a new industrial area on the beach. This major update is packed full with new content, from new weapons to base decorations. But by far the most impactful feature in this update has got to be procedural map generation. We have created a system from that ground up that utilizes new custom made points of interest to generate completely new Deadside maps with the click of a button. With this system, each wipe and each server will have a unique story.

Lots of effort has been put into these new POIs to create dynamic and fun areas to PvPvE in. You will see lots of new assets, buildings, missions, and large landmarks. For example, the scrapyard below will provide lots of densely packed scrap metal, creating both cover and loot. We also have the pyramid, an old rocket factory with high tier loot to offer.

Each map layout is generated from a string of numbers called a seed, with map sizes ranging from 1x1 to 4x4. There are over 2 million different possible seeds, offering a near limitless amount of maps to experience!
Some of the new procedural map points of interest will be added to Mirny as well! Specifically the factory, Pyramid and warehouse POIs. Here is the Pyramid on Mirny:

Also coming with this update is a new weapon; the Cross Vector! This iconic weapon spits .45 at a high rate of fire with controllable recoil using its uniquely engineered off-axis bolt travel. Here you can see it mounted on one of our new decorations, a weapon display!

While we are on the subject of weapons, explosives in this update will be getting a slight rework. Now in order to craft any explosives, you must first have an Explosives Workbench at your base. Once created, you will also need another new crafting material to make explosives; gunpowder. You can get gunpowder by disassembling ammunition at a workbench. Then it can be crafted into explosives, or maybe our new Improvised Grenade! These small grenades don’t deal as much damage compared to the real thing, but it's still a useful tool to have on hand.

Of course with the new year around the corner, it is time for us to begin our new years event! This event adds festive weapon skins into the loot pool, decorates the safezone, and adds new decorations to find. There are the weapon displays we mentioned before, decorative fences, a wooden pole, full body wolf and deer trophies, 2 desk lamps, 3 wall lamps, 8 new flag variants, and 22 wall mounted road signs! That's 42 new ways to make your base your own.

We have also continued to support and add new features to our modkit. In version 1.7, you will get the much requested ability to add modded items! We now have a system that registers your modded items with its own GUID, to prevent issues with replication that you may have experienced before if you tried this previously. We have also added support for custom chat commands, custom chat messages, expanded airdrop modding, and nodes to adjust player money. Tutorials are available on our Official Wiki for those who are willing to take the modding plunge. We can’t wait to see what our modders create with these new abilities!
There have been a lot more changes included in this version, so we encourage you to read the full patch notes!

As for our plans now that 1.7 has been released, we have a few things that we have already started working on. We plan to add a bunch of new weapon attachments like canted red dots, foregrips, lasers and more. There are two new weapons in the works; the Rsh-12 revolver and the improvised Mosin-K grenade launcher. Of course we plan to continue supporting our existing projects like the modkit, procedural generation, while also improving and adding upon existing features. Let us know what you would like to see next on our Nolt! It's the best place to send your ideas to us.

Version 0.12.0 is probably our largest update of the year so far, not only with the addition of proning, but changes to the overall gameplay experience. This update also brings a huge gunplay rebalance, which we think will hugely improve the overall weapon balance. Not only that, we believe that this new weapon gunplay system gives more control to the shooter, which will not only make the game more approachable, but also more competitive.

Before we go through the full list of changes and additions, first we would like to quickly cover the results of the recent public test. To all of you who participated in the public test, and filled out our survey, thank you, your feedback was very helpful in further refining this update. Here is a list of just changes we made after the release of the PTS, to save you the trouble of reading through the full patch notes again;

Rebalanced the prices of armor at traders again

One last note before we go into the patch notes, there will be no wipe included with this update, you will keep all progress

Now when you press , your character will go prone! This feature will open up so many new gameplay opportunities, for example, AI will have a much harder time spotting you while prone, helping you remain undetected. It can also greatly reduce your silhouette, which could be useful for fighting more dangerous AI.

For PvP, we are excited to see what players do with this new movement option. This position could be useful in so many situations, like holding a hallway from under a tire, or keeping yourself hidden while a squad rolls by. Importantly for PvP, the prone animations are extremely slow, which allows for punishing counterplay.
Version 0.12.0 has some major changes to gunplay, so many that we really don’t have the space to talk about each part in detail, so, here is a short rundown;
Weapon damage and cyclic rate rebalance, some weapons are going to change in “tier” by a lot
Weapon ballistics and accuracy rebalance, accurate weapons generally are now more accurate, inaccurate weapons now will be a bit worse.
Weapon default recoil is now less extreme, more predictable
Weapon recoil is much more predictable on semi-auto
Weapon recoil when looking down a scope with 2x or more magnification, now has 2x more recoil (does not apply to sniper rifles)
Weapon accuracy is slightly reduced when firing from the hip, M99 hip-fire is now very inaccurate.
Added visible tracers, but only to bullets that you fire, so that you can better track the trajectory. Tracers can be disabled if you prefer the old style.
Chest armor now protects more of the chest hitbox
Chest armor now has greater protection to most weapon types
Helmets now offer much worse protection, one headshot will always deal 50 damage minimum
All helmets now protect the entire head and face hitbox
Made bullet impact effects larger

This new weapon is a new variant of the standard AR4, offering a shorter barrel, and slightly better handling than your normal AR4. With a more modern and ergonomic look, this weapon will certainly be the main choice for some players out there

items.text: This new repair system will completely replace the old one, with this new system which incentivises looting guns out of areas, instead of breaking them down on the spot. Now, weapons can only be destroyed at a workbench. Luckily for those who don’t have a workbench at their base yet, we have added two workbenches at the safezones, however, you will be charged a fee whenever you use it.

Just like before, disassembling a weapon will give you the resulting spare parts. The amount of parts dropped, and needed for repair, has been rebalanced as well. Repair kits are now universal, and can be used on any weapon type. However, they now only drop from mission reward crates, and cannot be crafted.

This new system requires you to bring guns either back to your base, or to the safezone to be disassembled, so, we have given +1 weapon slot to backpacks that can hold weapons at all. This means you can hold up to 6 weapons at once with a stalker bag! And just to make it sweeter, all weapons can now fit in backpacks, with the exception of the M99.

items.text: On December 13th, at 4:00PM GMT / 8:00AM PDT, we will begin the release of version 0.10.0!
During the patch deployment, servers may be temporarily unavailable. Game client update is required.
The release of version 0.10.0 to the live servers will require a base wipe. All bases will need to be deleted for the update to function correctly on release.

In update 0.10.0, we introduce the largest POI in Deadside so far; Kamensk. This huge city is filled with new interesting buildings, good loot, and even unique “urban bandit” AI which can be found at a new epic mission. With the introduction of this city, we now have the possibility for true urban PvP. There are sure to be snipers hiding in windows, and people watching every long street for an easy kill.

This update also comes with a large map expansion in the southwest, however, the vast majority of this map expansion is open fields and forests at the moment. We plan to populate this area with POIs in the future, as the artists have been completely focused on getting Kamensk finished and playable. So in the meantime, this expanded area will provide tons of building space for players, especially for those who prefer to be far away from any potential respawn points, improving their chances of a successful raid defense.

Outside of the new city, this update comes with a handful of useful changes and improvements, one being optimization of the game’s graphical content. This was done mainly to improve performance in Kamensk, as we haven’t had an area this densely populated with objects before. However, these improvements should be felt in all of the POIs across the map, and will hopefully improve performance for everyone across the board.

Version 0.10.0 also comes with a minor change to AI, which will make a major difference in the actual gameplay. In this version, enemy AI will no longer fire their weapons, while strafing side to side. This will make combat against our hostile bots feel much more fair, as they are now forced to play by the same gunplay rules as the player. No longer will you see a bot strafing sideways at full speed, somehow getting hits on you a couple hundred meters away with a Mosin.

Update 0.8.0 brings back the seasonal content for Halloween, as well as some new features and changes. New features include Wolves, our first large animal in Deadside, and redesigned weapon models. We have also made some adjustments and improvements to other areas of the game, base building for example, is much cheaper than before.
For those unfamiliar with update 0.8.0, here are the full patch notes;

One of the main features of update 0.8.0, is the introduction of Wolves. These hostile animals patrol the map to ambush unsuspecting survivors. Anyone who is not prepared will be seriously injured, or worse. These Wolves will do a lot to make Deadside feel more dynamic and alive, with combat situations possible throughout more of the map.

One of the things that makes Deadside unique compared to other survival games, is how often players are forced to fire their weapons, usually to defend themselves from AI bandits. This makes PvP much more common compared to other games in the genre, because it's easier to track other players. With the introduction of wolves, this aspect of the game will be spread out to previously unpopulated areas of the map, where it wouldn’t make sense to have bandits wandering the area.

Not too long ago, we were able to hire an artist who specializes in weapon model design, and this has given us the ability to begin remodeling some of our older weapon models, without hindering any other aspect of development. In update 0.8.0, you will begin to see some of their work, with redesigned models of the AK-mod, AK-SU, AK-SM, VSD, and Skar. These new models are much higher fidelity than our old ones, and they enable the team to make more visual changes to the models than we previously could. Here is the new AK-mod model in game;

Version 0.8.0 will see the return of our seasonal Halloween items, this includes skull masks with glowing eyes, jack-o-lantern masks, bloody hockey masks that may coincidentally remind you of a certain Halloween movie, and lots of unique weapon skins with seasonal themes. Collect these items while you can though, they only come around once a year!

This update comes with many changes to game design that will change the gameplay in some big ways. For example, base building is now much cheaper than before. Depending on what you are trying to construct, the requirements could be 2-3.5X cheaper! Meaning much less of your time is spent holding left click on a tree to collect logs.

Another big design change is the increased accuracy of Sniper Rifles. In Deadside, weapons are not perfectly accurate, like real rifles, they have an average zone of impact. This zone is a circle that gets wider as distance increases, and smaller as distance decreases. We feel that Sniper Rifles up to this point have been a bit unrealistically inaccurate, leading to confusion among players as to why their bullets are not hitting the target. So, we have doubled the accuracy of all Sniper Rifles, which in practice, cuts that average impact zone in half. This will allow players to become much more consistent with their Snipers, allowing for a higher skill ceiling than before.

Version 0.7.0 is focused on improving features based directly on your community feedback, and generally improving the quality of life while playing Deadside. For those who aren’t already familiar with version 0.7.0, here are the patch notes included in our 0.7.0 PTS post;

The hostile AI now has a few extra abilities, like suppressive fire, while their reaction time has been made a bit more fair. The logic behind their detection of players has been changed, making stealth a more viable option at missions. And finally, the speed at which the AI can physically turn their bodies has been reduced, making flanking much more valuable. Getting an instant 180 headshot by an AI using a Mosin is not the experience we are aiming to deliver, and we hope these changes will eliminate that problem

The key for holding your breath to stabilize a shot has been moved from , to left . This will fix the issue of your character going into a sprint, and un-scoping, when you wish to hold your breath. This is a temporary measure, we will find a better solution that works within our character animation architecture.

Player fatigue has been removed in version 0.7.0, effectively giving players a much longer breath hold duration. The audio for holding your breath has been made much more clear as well, making it clear what your character is doing.

This feature will visually inform the player which direction they are taking damage from, representing the pain that your character feels. We were very careful to not make the damage indicators too distracting or intrusive, while remaining functional. This feature will be very useful when taking fire from multiple direction, at a hard mission for example

We have added an in game tutorial system to help new players on their first days in Deadside, avoiding any frustration or confusion that may happen when learning a new game. Located on the top right of the screen, the tutorial will give the players tips and instructions to progress

The assortment of items sold at the safezone traders has changed, they will no longer sell high tier weapons, but they will now sell some new items, like red dot sights, and vodka for sterile rags. The prices of items have been adjusted as well, to better balance the game economy.
Version 0.7.0 will give you the ability to queue into a full server, gone are the days of hitting resume or join over and over again.

We have left it up to the community to use these options, and to choose to play on this type of server if they like. There are many possibilities that open up with these settings, and we are interested to see what is done with them.

We have created new music for the main menu of the game, to fill the silence there. This will hopefully give the game more atmosphere, and set the tone for new players who are loading up the game for the first time.

In version 0.7.0, fishing has been changed a lot. You will now need to collect worms, but, you can now craft your own fishing rod, and catch two new types of fish; Perch and Burbot. These new fish types can be sold for a small profit, and one even provides more food value

items.text: These wells will provide water for players to collect with their Flasks. No longer will you be limited to searching for Sodas in towns, or going home to your water collector, you can now find consistent water sources while you are out exploring the world. As for the status of update 0.5.0, the team is still working hard on getting the boats to a complete and playable status. But what most people know me for, are my YouTube videos focused on Deadside, some of you may have seen my Insider Preview videos in previous posts like these. But now I have been selected for the role of Community Manager, and I’m extremely excited to begin communicating with you all.

Previously this role was filled by Lucas, and he did an excellent job, but unfortunately, his time was spread very thin between the community, and anti-cheat tasks. Now that I’m here, Lucas has a lot more time to devote towards anti-cheat and technical issues, while I can focus solely on communicating with you all. Today we have some bad news and good news for you, so let’s dive right in. First lets rip off the bandaid - we have to move the release of Hoverboats to the end of November. A huge thank you goes to all of you who helped us with a closed testing of this feature. It helped us uncover a major performance issue, that made the boats unplayable with 40-50 live players on the server. The fix requires a significant amount of Unreal Engine’s net driver code to be rewritten, among other things, so we decided to postpone the launch for a month. Fixing stuff in the engine’s core is never easy and we hope for your patience and understanding.

And now for the good news - this fix will bring a significant server performance increase in high player count situations and we expect a lot less issues tied to this. This means less rubberbanding, re-syncs, players and AI movement jitter, etc. Our art team will put the added time to good use as well, adding more islands content in time for Hoverboats release. We will start posting previews of this new region next week so stay tuned!

notes.title: Redesigned building mechanics and a new interface

items.text: 1.The base module menu has been changed to radial and is available by pressing the “B” key. Select a module by pressing the LMB while holding down B;
2.During the installation of a base module, the interface displays tools and resources necessary for building;
3. The character is no longer tied to the construction site: no more progress bars;
4. Three modules are available for simultaneous construction";
5. Resources needed to build a module can be added gradually during construction;
6. Canceling construction or disassembling a base module returns 50% of the resources spent.

We have added a workbench, a new base module and a feature that will allow you to apply camouflage on clothes. The functionality will be expanded in the future.. Steam Inventory integration is automatic.
Two test skins are added to your Steam inventory when you log into the game:
1 of the existing sets of skins for all players;
1 of the existing sets of skins for owners of the Supporter pack.

notes.title: New effects of bullets hitting various surfaces

items.text: More dust, sparks and blood: more realistic visuals that also have practical purpose. Now the point of impact of a bullet is more noticeable, which helps you adjust the firing faster during combat.
Fixed an infinite stack of corner base walls;
Fixed collision of bullets and a character with a world blocker;
Fixed the inability of the server to restart without players online;
Fixed the walkie-talkie reactions to fast travel NPCs;
Fixed incorrect rendering distance of the placed explosive charge.
Please, take the SURVEY after testing: it helps us make the game better. You can edit your answers at any moment.

The release of the 0.3.0 update on the live servers will be accompanied by a wipe. All bases will be taken down. Craft kits of the base modules stored in the inventory will also be deleted. Other items placed in the safe zone storage will not be affected by wipe.

You can now travel quickly between safe zones while carrying your equipment;

Dog tags are back as currency for fast travel. Can seldom be found in hidden stashes (5% chance) or obtained by completing missions: [table =equalcells]

Transferring modified weapons. Now weapons equipped with mods can be placed in a backpack or storage without having to remove modifiers or sсopes;: PLEASE, NOTE: For now, you cannot switch the currently equipped weapon by dragging a modded weapon to a weapon slot. This feature will be added to the game with the next update.
All animations of pistol handling have been redesigned (basic grips, moving, reloading);
Added in-game notifications about upcoming maintenance on the server;
Added new Steam achievements;
Added new decorations and environmental details.
Axe and knife attacks do not cause damage to low objects (respawn beacon);

The “Take all” button does not equip items from the ground into the hot bar;
